q1_issues.issue: "leaves silken threads" is given Patient, but depositing threads does not create, destroy, consume or physically change them, so the object test — and the explicit "when the test is unclear, default to Theme" instruction — yields Theme.

The consequent Skolem (sk_leave $x $y) is not a function of the trigger event variable $e even though $e is a universal in the premise scoping over it, so repeated landings by the same moth on the same lantern collapse into one leaving event.

q2_gaps: Generic "when <clause>, <clause>" conditional: "when" is listed among the temporal connectives that keep their time-section forms, while only "every time / whenever" (an occurrence rule whose response is tied to its trigger with During) and indicative "if" (a plain Implication) get rule treatments; which of these a bare generic "when"-clause takes, and whether a During link is owed, is not addressed.

An orthographically single compound word ("nightmoth"): whether it is a single lemma owing no decomposition, or a modifier_noun compound owing a genus atom, is not addressed — the parse keeps the unsplit symbol yet still emits (Inheritance nightmoth moth).
